pre_workout.text: I know you don't feel like it. That's exactly why you're going. Get up, and let's move.
You won't regret showing up. You'll only regret staying home. Let's go.
Just the first ten minutes. That's all I'm asking. Start, and the rest takes care of itself.
Champions aren't made on the days they feel great. They're made on days like today. Move.
Future you is begging you to get up right now. Don't let them down.

grind.text: This is the moment. Right here. Push through it.
Your body wants to quit. Your mind decides. Keep going.
This is where the work happens. Stay in it.
Breathe, focus, and drive. You're stronger than this.
Don't count the reps. Make the reps count. Keep pushing.

finish.text: One more. Just one more. You've got it in you.
Finish strong. Leave nothing behind. Go.
This last one is the one that matters most. Send it.
Empty the tank. Right now. Finish.

steady.text: Smooth and steady. You're right where you need to be. Hold it.
This is your pace. Own it. Keep rolling.
Every step is progress. Keep that rhythm.
